description: A script that is not a bare hook_pre_*.sh or .py file name of a regular file in the hook directory is logged in one line and never run (each would create its canary): an absolute path, a path with /, .., a symlink to a file outside the directory, the other fire point's prefix, another extension, a directory, a missing file, a dangling symlink. An empty or blank script is not selected at all, so it is not logged. A symlink to a file inside the directory runs under its own name, and the hooks after the refused ones still run.

expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 script '{root}/hooks/hook_pre_real.sh' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping
[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 script 'sub/hook_pre_sub.sh' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping
[ pfB Hook ] pre #2 script '../hook_pre_outside.sh' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping
[ pfB Hook ] pre #3 script '..' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping
[ pfB Hook ] pre #4 script 'hook_pre_link.sh' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping
[ pfB Hook ] pre #5 script 'hook_post_wrong.sh' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping
[ pfB Hook ] pre #6 script 'hook_pre_text.txt' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping
[ pfB Hook ] pre #7 script 'hook_pre_dir.sh' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping
[ pfB Hook ] pre #8 script 'hook_pre_missing.sh' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping
[ pfB Hook ] pre #9 script 'hook_pre_dangling.sh' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping

[ pfB Hook ] pre #10 (hook_pre_alias.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #10 completed

[ pfB Hook ] pre #11 (hook_pre_ok.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #11 completed
